reference: Idempotent reconciliation with replay-qualified immutable source handoffs
scope: The existing mutation controller prepares bounded, preserved review candidates. It does not gain authority to merge or deploy them.

cases.requirement: Planning changes no source, registry or publication state and invokes no model or network operation.
The unchanged source-capsule capability restores the selected committed source bytes, not mutable checkout content.
Preparation preserves a complete revision-bound proposal and actual qualification evidence, without claiming submission or deployment.
Repeating a completed request returns its existing verified result without regenerating work or minting duplicate evidence.
An intentionally changed proposal, capsule, source identity or qualification receipt is rejected.
Only declared, bounded candidate paths are transported; unsafe paths, uncommitted drift and undeclared changes fail explicitly.
A failed or empty improvement cannot be promoted as a useful proposal merely because feed, timestamp or frame metadata changed.
Denied publication preserves the prepared candidate and truthful state; it cannot trigger a main push, issue closure or false deployment.
Qualification uses explicitly allowed local checks. A helper, registry label or retry cannot silently invoke a model, remote publication or another scheduler.
Existing legacy mutation entrypoints and failure behavior remain compatible; approval, public-soak and ledger policies are not weakened.
Concurrent identical requests cannot both generate or overwrite one another; a contender sees an explicit busy, existing-result or rejected state.
An interrupted preparation retains a truthful recovery boundary and does not silently restart generation or relabel partial files as qualified.
A relocated preserved proposal replays against its explicit historical base after original staging is removed; current-base readiness remains separately strict.
Prompt size does not grant more authority: the executor exposes only its owned input reader, isolates configuration and Git context, and bounds capture and owned-process lifetime.
Missing or expired preserved bytes cause an explicit unavailable/invalid result, never a fake cache hit, automatic regeneration or deployment claim.

limitations: Source-capsule qualification proves selected-source transport and replay, not application functionality, adoption, independent repository ownership or deployment.
An independent read-only critic must also exercise the completed output. A passing machine gate alone is not the final review.
